findings.title: Retain the routing layout node index
findings.avoidedCost: Rebuilding the node-key Map on every connection-preview/selection publication.
findings.evidence: The production memo is owned by layout.nodes; pure index tests retain exact node identity and authoritative keys.
findings.limitations: A changed layout node collection rebuilds the map; there is no global graph cache.

findings.title: Index routing edge models
findings.avoidedCost: A linear graph.edges.find for each displayed edge on every view render.
findings.evidence: First duplicate edge authority is preserved; edge handles now perform Map lookups from a graph.edges-owned memo.
findings.limitations: Immutable graph.edges identity owns invalidation; selected handles and labels still update.

findings.title: Prepare routing endpoint label catalogs once
findings.avoidedCost: Reconstructing source/destination catalogs and scanning them separately for every edge accessibility label.
findings.evidence: The source and destination label maps are prepared once from project/graph candidates; duplicate option labels retain first-match semantics. Existing mounted routing tests preserve current-copy feedback and accessibility behavior.
findings.limitations: Project, graph and destination options own labels; per-edge localized accessibility templates are still filled on actual renders.

findings.title: Group routing destination ports by node
findings.avoidedCost: Repeated find/filter traversals over all destination ports for every routing card.
findings.evidence: One preparation traversal retains normal-port first match and the original order of multiple effect sidechains.
findings.limitations: Destination candidate collection changes rebuild the groups.

findings.title: Accumulate routing connection counts once
findings.avoidedCost: Two graph-edge filters for each routing node plus repeated VCA member searches.
findings.evidence: Two disabled duplicate edges still count as two outgoing/incoming connections. Five hundred prepared count lookups cause zero additional source getter reads.
findings.limitations: All edges remain counted, including disabled ones; VCA members own their output count. Graph identity invalidates preparation.

findings.title: Select spatial routing navigation targets without sorting
findings.avoidedCost: Copying and sorting reading order on every arrow key and sorting the directional candidate array.
findings.evidence: 3000 deterministic dense layout/direction comparisons exactly match the original stable-sort reference, including ties, missing keys, Home and End. The production path uses bounded linear scans.
findings.limitations: The current finite layout coordinates remain the navigation contract; input order resolves equal-distance ties.

findings.title: Retain static routing wire React children
findings.avoidedCost: Recreating every static SVG wire path element during connection-preview/selection renders.
findings.evidence: Thirty mounted parent publications read an unchanged wire path once; a replaced edge collection updates the actual SVG d attribute.
findings.limitations: Only static wires are memoized. Preview paths, handles, focus and selected state continue to render.

findings.title: Coalesce routing preview hover publication and bounds reads
findings.avoidedCost: A getBoundingClientRect read and React point update for every pointer-move sample.
findings.evidence: One hundred queued samples produce one bounds read/publication with the latest coordinates, live scroll offsets and zoom. Disable, explicit cancel and unmount remove pending frames.
findings.limitations: Only transient connection-preview drawing is deferred. Connecting, cancelling and zoom changes fence pending geometry.

findings.title: Retain spreadsheet row identity serialization
findings.avoidedCost: Mapping every row id and joining the row-reset token on each selection/draft publication.
findings.evidence: Thirty mounted updates cause no extra id getter reads; changed rows rebuild the identity; locale changes leave it unchanged.
findings.limitations: Immutable row membership/order owns the reset token, preserving existing draft reset semantics.

findings.title: Retain spreadsheet cell presentation metadata
findings.avoidedCost: Repeated editability column searches, read-only title selection and row accessibility-label formatting for every cell render.
findings.evidence: Thirty unrelated publications cause no additional editable getter reads; locale changes refresh read-only titles and pitch-link changes refresh editability.
findings.limitations: The row collection and resolved copy own metadata. Blocking and active selection remain live row props.

findings.title: Skip unaffected spreadsheet row React rendering
findings.avoidedCost: Rebuilding every cell and event closure across all rows when one active cell/draft changes.
findings.evidence: Thirty parent publications cause zero extra cell value getter reads for unchanged rows. Selected/active props and a changed row draft refresh the expected row. A mounted production panel sends an edit through the current controller after a parent controller change.
findings.limitations: Per-row selected columns, active column, draft, blocking, input ref and prepared metadata are memo props; stable dispatchers read current handlers.

findings.title: Focus spreadsheet cells through a mounted-cell index
findings.avoidedCost: A table querySelector traversal and selector-string construction on each keyboard or selection focus transfer.
findings.evidence: The mounted production panel navigates with table.querySelector replaced by a throwing sentinel and commits the expected current-controller edit. Ref cleanup empties the direct index after unmount.
findings.limitations: Only mounted cells are indexed; reordered rows update their coordinate registrations. Document/project ownership remains in the existing keyed surface.

findings.title: Retain the legacy compressor transfer graph
findings.avoidedCost: Recomputing the three-point legacy compressor path on unrelated UI publications.
findings.evidence: Thirty mounted publications read threshold once and retain the curve; replaced parameters rebuild it. Existing legacy exact-geometry tests pass.
findings.limitations: This is the legacy 3.7.7 graph, distinct from the sampled modern compressor curve. Immutable parameters own the path.

findings.title: Retain Auto Duck envelope geometry
findings.avoidedCost: Recomputing six envelope points, path strings and five control positions on unrelated UI publications.
findings.evidence: Thirty mounted publications read duck amount once and retain the envelope; replaced parameters refresh it. Existing wx integer-truncation geometry tests pass.
findings.limitations: Changed duck parameters still recompute geometry immediately. Pointer/control interactions retain original behavior.

findings.title: Retain classic filter response projection
findings.avoidedCost: Projecting 400 response points and formatting the SVG line on renders with unchanged gain data and dB viewport.
findings.evidence: Thirty unchanged mounted publications preserve response identity. A changed dB viewport changes the line and every point equals the independent public gain evaluator projection.
findings.limitations: Both minimumDb and maximumDb invalidate projection; no default viewport substitutes for the current plot.

findings.title: Reuse classic filter gain analysis across dB viewport changes
findings.avoidedCost: Rebuilding biquad coefficients and reevaluating 400 frequency gains when only the displayed dB range changes.
findings.evidence: Changing minimumDb/maximumDb causes zero additional cutoff reads while refreshing the projected path. Parameter/rate changes rebuild analysis; 96kHz refreshes the actual 48kHz Nyquist bound.
findings.limitations: The per-mounted-plot 400 gain points add bounded retained storage. Parameters and actual sample rate own analysis; arithmetic matches the original evaluator.

findings.title: Retain classic filter frequency ruler ticks
findings.avoidedCost: Rebuilding logarithmic frequency tick positions and labels for every dB viewport/control publication.
findings.evidence: Frequency tick identity survives changed dB ranges and cutoff updates, but actual Nyquist changes refresh ticks. Existing graph-render parity remains green.
findings.limitations: Normalized minimum/maximum frequencies own the ruler. Dynamic dB ticks and labels remain tied to the current dB viewport.

findings.title: Prepare localized effect picker search labels
findings.avoidedCost: Resolving and lowercasing each effect label again for each search query or unrelated picker update.
findings.evidence: Thirty mounted publications make no extra localized-label reads; replaced effect types/copy rebuild the catalog and produce the expected localized lowercased search text.
findings.limitations: The effect-type collection and copy identity own labels. Query filtering and current matching choices remain live.

findings.title: Retain preset option display decoration
findings.avoidedCost: Rebuilding custom-preset label suffixes and selected unsaved markers on unchanged preset-bar publications.
findings.evidence: Thirty updates make no additional preset-label reads and retain options; selected-id changes refresh the unsaved display marker. Existing default/reset/save/About tests pass.
findings.limitations: Preset entries, selected id, unsaved state and localized custom label all invalidate decoration. First-match selected preset authority is retained.

findings.title: Retain default-preset parameter equality
findings.avoidedCost: Repeated key-set allocation and JSON comparison for an unchanged default/current parameter pair.
findings.evidence: Thirty mounted updates cause no extra parameter getter reads. Replaced current/default parameters switch the edited result to false as expected.
findings.limitations: The default-baseline enabled flag and both parameter objects own the exact existing samePresetParams comparison.

findings.title: Admit About metadata only for an open About dialog
findings.avoidedCost: Building effect title, category/source/license/native facts on every closed preset-bar publication.
findings.evidence: Thirty closed renders perform zero subject-type reads; opening builds metadata, and another stable open render retains it. Existing About/menu tests preserve availability, including disabled preset operations. Two additional regressions preserve the original non-null boundary for an empty identifier.
findings.limitations: About availability uses the original non-null subject boundary, including an empty identifier; effect/copy/open changes invalidate metadata. No new UI control is added.

findings.title: Retain control-track dropdown options
findings.avoidedCost: Filtering audio control tracks and mapping labels during each unrelated effect parameter render.
findings.evidence: Thirty mounted updates cause no extra track-name reads; a replaced track collection refreshes candidates. Existing control-track eligibility tests pass.
findings.limitations: Tracks, target-track exclusion and requiresControlTrack/hideControlTrack admission own choices. Non-control effects skip preparation.

findings.title: Retain native effect parameter admission

source.productionCaller: Soundscaper AudioEditorEffectsOverlay rack via LazyEffectParameterEditor and SelectionEffectsDialog direct EffectParameterEditor

findings.avoidedCost: Enumerating native effect parameters, filtering supported numeric/choice and advanced controls, and reconstructing the layout descriptor on unrelated presentation publications.
findings.evidence: Mounted production EffectParameterEditor enumerates native parameters31times before and once after across30 disabled-state publications. Replaced parameters, effect type and advanced controls refresh the displayed fields; existing Nyquist/native layout and automation tests pass.
findings.limitations: Existing immutable effect.params publication owns invalidation. Parameter edits still refresh the descriptor; this does not cache current values or gesture callbacks.

findings.title: Retain localized Audacity enum options

source.productionCaller: Soundscaper SelectionEffectsDialog direct EffectParameterEditor for Audacity effects

findings.avoidedCost: Rebuilding string-valued option objects and rerunning Audacity enum option searches/localization when numeric values or disabled state change.
findings.evidence: Mounted production EffectParameterEditor option-localization getter reads grow4to64 before and remain4 after30 actual targetLufs value publications. Replaced copy displays localized options; switching to Distortion rebuilds the same-named mode options.
findings.limitations: Descriptor, effectType, parameter name and copy own enum presentation; current selected value, disabled state and automation callbacks remain live.

findings.title: Retain standard Audacity effect card grouping
findings.avoidedCost: Repeating definition Object.keys, available/assigned Sets and group/remainder filtering on value-only updates.
findings.evidence: Thirty mounted updates enumerate the same definition proxy once while preserving parameter order; a new descriptor parameter is rendered exactly once. Existing port/group/gate tests pass.
findings.limitations: Effect type and immutable definition.params own grouping. Port layout admission remains unchanged; newly constructed definitions still invalidate.

findings.title: Retain the sampled modern compressor transfer graph
findings.avoidedCost: Reevaluating 200 soft-knee samples and formatting both line/fill SVG paths during unrelated compressor presentation updates.
findings.evidence: Thirty mounted updates perform no extra threshold reads and preserve both paths; replaced parameters match the existing public 200-sample builder exactly. Existing compressor/limiter layout tests pass.
findings.limitations: The full immutable parameter object owns the graph. This is distinct from the three-point legacy compressor finding and prior Graphic/Filter Curve EQ retention.

findings.title: Index normalized Vamp analyzers and outputs
findings.avoidedCost: Linear selected-analyzer and selected-output scans on each parameter/program/scope/result UI publication.
findings.evidence: Thirty mounted updates cause no additional analyzer/output id reads; changed catalogs refresh the lookup. Duplicate id fixtures preserve the original first-match authority and existing request/abort/result tests pass.
findings.limitations: The normalized catalog analyzer collection owns the indexes. Missing selection still falls back to the original first analyzer/output.

findings.title: Retain adjacent take-comp shared boundaries
findings.avoidedCost: Scanning every comp-region adjacency and allocating boundary records for every boundary draft keystroke.
findings.evidence: Thirty mounted updates cause no extra region-end reads; changed region geometry refreshes shared boundaries, while gaps remain excluded. Existing project-change/take-choice/operation tests pass.
findings.limitations: Immutable compRegions owns adjacency, independently of local boundary drafts. Snapshot model changes can still rebuild collections.

findings.title: Retain Morse summary across unrelated generator controls
findings.avoidedCost: Reencoding and timing the same Morse text whenever amplitude/frequency/pending presentation changes.
findings.evidence: Thirty mounted updates preserve summary identity; changed text and words-per-minute match summarizeMorseCode exactly, and leaving Morse clears the summary. Existing generator pending/cancel tests pass.
findings.limitations: Generator type, text and words-per-minute are all summary dependencies; unsupported/empty messages keep the existing nonthrowing preview semantics.

findings.title: Retain generator locale number/unit formatters
findings.avoidedCost: Constructing Intl.NumberFormat repeatedly for every displayed DTMF timing number or Morse dot duration.
findings.evidence: Thirty Morse publications construct one unit formatter. Locale changes rebuild it; DTMF admits two formatters, retains them across control publications, and tone/noise admits none. Formatting equals the original maximum-three-digits localized second-unit options.
findings.limitations: Type, locale and fixed formatter options own instances. Values are formatted live; no formatted-value cache is introduced.
